arxiv-2012-11818.title: X-ray flares from the stellar tidal disruption by a candidate supermassive black hole binary
arxiv-2012-11818.creator: Xinwen Shu 1∗, Wenjie Zhang 1, Shuo Li 2, Ning Jiang 3, Liming Dou 4, Zhen Yan 5, Fu-Guo Xie 5, Rongfeng Shen 6, Luming Sun 1, Fukun Liu 7,8, Tinggui Wang 3
arxiv-2012-11818.description: Abstract Optical transient surveys have led to the discovery of dozens of stellar tidal disruption events (TDEs) by massive black hole in the centers of galaxies. Despite extensive searches, X-ray follow-up observations have produced no or only weak X-ray detections in most of them.

arxiv-2111-08515.title: Local News Online and COVID in the U.S.: Relationships among Coverage, Cases, Deaths, and Audience
arxiv-2111-08515.creator: Kenneth Joseph, Benjamin D. Horne, Jon Green, John P. Wihbey
arxiv-2111-08515.description: Abstract We present analyses from a real-time information monitoring system of online local news in the U.S. We study relationships among online local news coverage of COVID, cases and deaths in an area, and properties of local news outlets and their audiences.

arxiv-2201-06676.title: Observing how deep neural networks understand physics through the energy spectrum of one-dimensional quantum mechanics
arxiv-2201-06676.creator: Kenzo Ogure
arxiv-2201-06676.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kenzo Ogure. We investigated how neural networks(NNs) understand physics using one-dimensional quantum mechanics. After training an NN to accurately predict energy eigenvalues from potentials, we used it to confirm the NN’s understanding of physics from four different aspects. The trained NN could predict energy eigenvalues of different kinds of potentials than the ones learned, predict the probability distribution of the existence of particles not used during training, reproduce untrained physical phenomena, and predict the energy eigenvalues of potentials with unknown matter effect.

arxiv-2302-13522.title: IGB: Addressing The Gaps In Labeling, Features, Heterogeneity, and Size of Public Graph Datasets for Deep Learning Research Conference: Proceedings of the 29th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 6–10, 2023; Long Beach, CA, USA Proceedings of the 29th ACM SIGKDD Conf
arxiv-2302-13522.creator: Arpandeep Khatua, Vikram Sharma Mailthody, Bhagyashree Taleka, Tengfei Ma, Xiang Song, Wen-mei Hwu
arxiv-2302-13522.description: Abstract . Graph neural networks (GNNs) have shown high potential for a variety of real-world, challenging applications, but one of the major obstacles in GNN research is the lack of large-scale flexible datasets. Most existing public datasets for GNNs are relatively small, which limits the ability of GNNs to generalize to unseen data.

arxiv-2312-05221.title: Analytic bootstrap for magnetic impurities
arxiv-2312-05221.creator: Lorenzo Bianchi
arxiv-2312-05221.description: Abstract We study the O(3) critical model and the free theory of a scalar triplet in the presence of a magnetic impurity. We use analytic bootstrap techniques to extract results in the ε {\varepsilon} -expansion. First, we extend by one order in perturbation theory the computation of the beta function for the defect coupling in the free theory.

arxiv-2503-21159.title: Multi-Objective Optimization for Privacy-Utility Balance in Differentially Private Federated Learning
arxiv-2503-21159.creator: Kanishka Ranaweera, David Smith, Pubudu N. Pathirana, Ming Ding, Thierry Rakotoarivelo, Aruna Seneviratne
arxiv-2503-21159.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw data, making it a promising approach for privacy-preserving machine learning. However, ensuring differential privacy (DP) in FL presents challenges due to the trade-off between model utility and privacy protection.

arxiv-2507-14094.title: ChemZz I: Comparing Oxygen and Iron Abundance Patterns in the Milky Way, the Local Group and Cosmic Noon 2026 ChemZz I: Comparing Oxygen and Iron Abundance Patterns in the Milky Way, the Local Group and Cosmic Noon – References
arxiv-2507-14094.creator: Stephanie Monty, Allison L. Strom, Thomas M. Stanton, Martyna Chruślińska, Fergus Cullen, Chiaki Kobayashi, Tjitske Starkenburg, Souradeep Bhattacharya, Jason L. Sanders, Mark Gieles
arxiv-2507-14094.description: Abstract Our understanding of the chemical evolution of galaxies has advanced through measurements from both distant galaxies across redshift, and our own Milky Way (MW). To form a comprehensive picture, it is essential to unify these constraints, placing them on a common scale and parlance and to understand their systematic differences.

europmc-pmc4674971.title: On the analysis of movement smoothness.
europmc-pmc4674971.creator: Balasubramanian S, Melendez-Calderon A, Roby-Brami A, Burdet E.
europmc-pmc4674971.description: Quantitative measures of smoothness play an important role in the assessment of sensorimotor impairment and motor learning. Traditionally, movement smoothness has been computed mainly for discrete movements, in particular arm, reaching and circle drawing, using kinematic data....

pmc-11436747.title: Mapping decadal land cover dynamics in Sicily’s coastal regions
pmc-11436747.creator: Pietro Scala, Alexandra Toimil, Moisés Álvarez-Cuesta, Giorgio Manno, Giuseppe Ciraolo
pmc-11436747.description: Coastal zones are dynamic interfaces shaped by the interplay of Land Cover (LC) and Land Use (LU), influenced by both natural processes and anthropogenic activities. Grasping the historical shifts in land is essential for safeguarding coastal benefits such as defense mechanisms, biodiversity conservation, and recreational spaces, alongside enhancing their management.

pmc-11485385.title: Diagnostic value of a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based vertebral bone quality score for bone mineral density assessment: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11485385.creator: Dandan Yang, Chuan Liu, Qiaojun Hu
pmc-11485385.description: BackgroundMany studies have explored the application of the magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based vertebral bone quality (VBQ) score as a tool for opportunistic osteoporosis screening before spine surgery. We aimed to conduct a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies to determine the diagnostic value of the VBQ score for bone mineral density (BMD) assessment.

pmc-11651892.title: On the consequences of intra-operative release versus over-tensioning of the posterior cruciate ligament in total knee arthroplasty
pmc-11651892.creator: Seyyed Hamed Hosseini Nasab, Sabrina Hörmann, Thomas M Grupp, William R Taylor, Allan Maas
pmc-11651892.description: Intra-operative tensioning of the posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) in total knee arthroplasty (TKA) is commonly based on the surgeon’s experience, resulting in a possibly loose or overly tight PCL. To date, the consequences of different PCL tensioning scenarios for the post-operative biomechanics of the knee remain unclear.

pmc-12670951.title: Implementation of a stepped anti-inflammatory reliever therapy intervention with budesonide-formoterol 160/4·5 mcg by Turbuhaler versus usual care for adults presenting during exacerbations of obstructive lung disease suggestive of asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease in a resource-limite

pmc-12670951.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). pmc-13118063.title: Clinical Efficacy and Biomechanical Behavior of Different Compression Systems in Venous Ulcers: Pressure, Stiffness and Healing
pmc-13118063.creator: Juan Francisco Jiménez García, Maria Piedad García Ruiz, Francisco González Jiménez, Maria Gutierrez García, Jose Luis Jiménez Laínez, Mercedes Muñoz Condez, Ana Belen Fernández Ramirez, Francisco Pedro García Fernández
pmc-13118063.description: Introduction: Venous leg ulcers are the most severe manifestation of chronic venous insufficiency, and their treatment is based on compression therapy, whose effectiveness depends on the magnitude of the pressure and the biomechanical properties of the system. Doubts persist about the actual correlation between interface pressure, bandage stiffness and clinical outcomes in real-world practice.

pmc-13470365.title: Development and validation of an explainable model for Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection in children
pmc-13470365.creator: Xin Yang, Liwen Zhang, Yong Yin, Hejun Jiang, Guijun Yang, Zhichao Sun, Yunqin Zhang, Juan Cui, Guifang Zhou, Na Wang, Jing Chen
pmc-13470365.description: This study aimed to develop an explainable early diagnostic model for Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP) infection in children and assess clinicians’ perceptions before and after its deployment. Data were collected from children with acute fever or cough at Linyi Maternal and Child Healthcare Hospital and Shanghai Children’s Medical Center in 2023.
